newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares hit highs, rally seen continuing.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares hit highs, rally seen continuing.

text.p: Share prices nudged highs on Friday and brokers said there was no reason why the bullish run should stop next week.
The market's general index rose 1.17 percent to 2,285.10 in turnover of 3.9 billion crowns.
Mortgage bank Stadshypotek climbed 10 crowns to 200 ahead of the deadline for the submission of bids in the state's auction of its 34 percent stake.
Telecoms firm Ericsson closed at 207 crowns, up 3.5, after touching a record of 209.5 on a rumour of an order which Stockholm markets said could be worth billions of crowns.
"What I've heard is that it's a PCS order for 2.2 billion crowns from the U.S.. In the contract there are three or four follow-up orders of the same size," a broker said. Ericsson had no comment.
Astra edged up 0.5 crown to 322, not managing to extend earlier gains made on rumours of a takeover by Swiss rival Roche.
"Wall Street is showing that it can hold up at these levels so there is probably not that much that could stop Stockholm from running higher," one broker said.
